title: Poco M8 Power to debut next week with an 8,000mAh battery
summary: Poco India confirmed the Poco M8 Power will launch on August 4 in India via Flipkart. The teaser reveals an 8,000mAh battery, a 50MP primary rear camera and an orange textured rear panel. The phone is expected to be a rebranded Redmi Note 17, potentially featuring a 7-inch OLED, Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset and an 8MP front camera.
content:
Siddharth — 27 July 2026

Poco India has officially announced that the Poco M8 Power will be unveiled on August 4 and sold in India through Flipkart. The company posted a teaser showing the handset in an orange color option with a textured rear panel and confirmed two key hardware highlights: an 8,000mAh battery and a 50MP primary rear camera.

References to the Poco M8 Power had previously appeared in HyperOS firmware, suggesting an imminent launch. The official confirmation from Poco India follows those firmware hints and sets a precise launch date for early August.

The Poco M8 Power is widely expected to be a rebranded Redmi Note 17, which made its debut the previous week. If the rebranding holds true, the M8 Power could inherit many of the Note 17's specifications, including a large 7-inch OLED display, the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset and an 8MP front-facing camera.

Poco's teaser focused on the battery and camera, both areas that matter to many buyers: an 8,000mAh cell would place the handset among phones with exceptionally large capacity, while a 50MP primary camera suggests an emphasis on imaging capability for the segment.

Official specifications, pricing and availability details beyond the India launch and Flipkart availability will be revealed at the August 4 event. Until then, the industry expects the M8 Power to closely mirror the Redmi Note 17's design and internals, with any market-specific tweaks for the Poco brand and Indian retail channels.

Expect more detailed coverage after the announcement, including hands-on impressions, full spec confirmation and pricing information for different configurations.
